output.summary: A flowering plant native to North and South America, false daisy commonly grows in moist warm-temperate to tropical places. It has hairy opposite leaves and small white flower heads. In Southeast Asia, Balinese people cook it as a vegetable, while Javanese people eat the herb as part of lalap.
